notes.title: Hotfix 1.1.0.21 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The grind never ends! We've fixed some of the most critical issues with the Working From Home update!

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where The Impostor could become invincible and also unable to damage Jackie, soft locking the run
[*] Fixed an exploit causing Team Player to make Jackie invincible while accompanied by certain invincible companions
[*] Prevented players from getting permanently stuck out of bounds in Cubicle Tower
[*] Fixed an issue where bringing Disaster Proof into Cubicle Tower as your pinned skill would break the game
[*] The Employee Kiosks in Fizzle now properly open the Resume again instead of the Rolodex
[*] Corrected a few typos in dialogue
[/list]

All these fixes will be coming to consoles along with the Working From Home Update itself in a matter of weeks! Thanks for your patience, and happy interning!

notes.title: The Working From Home Update is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/7581f720555fa90f377a2b9fa4c6f4005eaeafc2.gif[/img]
[i]literally us rn[/i]

[h2]CONTENT CONTENT CONTENT[/h2]
What’s poppin bebs! We just launched the Working From Home update for Going Under. That’s right, it’s out RIGHT NOW! You can PLAY IT! (Coming to consoles ASAP, we promise!)

For this update, we wanted to address some of the biggest gaps we and the players saw in the gameplay, to make it a better experience for people playing for the first time, as well as add content to give experienced players something new to tackle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/077ccc707eb4b533f45bdac8b73371be41f7987f.gif[/img]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5PUwQYBM_uc][i]Also watch our sick new animated trailer!![/i][/url]

[h2]Impostor Syndrome[/h2]
To that end, the biggest feature in this update is IMPOSTOR MODE. A lot of players have been asking for the ability to play the dungeons one after the other in more of a “True Roguelike” setting, so we’re giving the people what they want! Not only can you challenge the game’s core 3 dungeons in a single run, you’ll get to banish a new final boss: The Impostor.

To unlock Impostor Mode, you’ll need to beat the game’s first 4 dungeons, and then encounter The Impostor in a normal dungeon run. We’ll let you figure out the rest ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/940e212262545c2164339709a7ae654a213774bb.gif[/img]

Not only that, but there are 7 levels of Overtime, our scaling difficulty system similar to Slay the Spire’s Ascension. And they get STUPID hard. Even experienced interns will be at this one for quite a while.

[h2]But wait, there's more![/h2]
Easily the most requested feature was the ability to play old dungeons that get locked off for plot reasons. We’re finally caving to public opinion and letting you play the original 3 dungeons whenever you want with the flick of a lever! No more grinding the insanely hard dungeons to get your mentorships finished.

We’ve also got the Rolodex, our game’s version of a bestiary. By picking up business cards in the dungeon and capturing enemies in them, you’ll be able to learn more about the game’s lore, or just read whatever stupid jokes Caelan felt like putting in there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/bdb88ff9ccf0ffac35fb315d1241b2cab6edfc42.gif[/img]
[i]Nick wrote only one out of 57 and it was this one[/i]

Feel like taking a break? Jackie now has a room to hang out in! You can change outfits (yes, there are OUTFITS!), listen to the songs you’ve heard in-game, and start Impostor Mode runs from the comfort of your own room.

Finally, there’s a whole bunch of new Skills, Curses, weapons, and secrets to discover in the existing game as well as Impostor Mode. There are now a total of 99 Skills in the game! Can you get them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/0d5068774de7e3ef74562e841cbbdfd9ebb9c1c6.gif[/img]
[i]Good luck babyface, looks like you'll need it.[/i]

We worked our butts off on this update, and we really hope you guys have fun with it. It couldn't have been done without the amazing community and the passion you guys have shown for the world of Going Under, so thank you!!! (Random thought...we're only 40 reviews away from an Overwhelmingly Positive hmmmmːGoOverː) Til next time, when we'll have even more hype stuff to share.

<3 ːAggroCrabː

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
Full patch notes are below! As always, let us know what you think of the update in the comments or in our [url=discord.gg/AggroCrab]Discord[/url], or even just @ us on [url=twitter.com/AggroCrabGames]Twitter[/url].
[h3]Major Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Jackie’s Room can now be unlocked, allowing access to costume selection, an OST player, and the new gamemode: Impostor Mode.
[*] Impostor Mode: Run the 3 main dungeons one after the other, and face down your Impostor in this “True Roguelite” mode. Beat the additional difficulty options to earn new costumes!
[*] Rolodex: Capture your enemies in business cards to learn more about them! Complete your co-workers’ mentorships to unlock their cards as well.
[*] Old dungeons can now be accessed in the latter half of the game by pulling the levers near the slides in Fizzle.
[*] 25 new Skills to unlock and find in the dungeon
[*] 9 new Curses for the Hauntrepreneur to challenge you with
[*] 24 new items to wield, including the fabled [b]Legendary Weapons[/b]
[*] A new app -- Cubicle Reverb
[*] A new flavor of Fizzle??
[*] Added your best time successfully clearing a dungeon to the stats card on the entrance slide.
[*] Some new secrets to discover 👀
[/list]
[h3]Balance Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the trigger odds of Win Friends & Influence Monsters and Aggro Crab’s Blessing.
[*] Reworked the order that Skills are unlocked in, including changing which Skills are available on a fresh save file.
[*] The Hauntrepreneur’s Shop no longer has a chance to spawn 2 health upgrades.
[*] Weapon prices in shops no longer increase as much as you descend through the dungeon.
[*] Extended spear hitboxes across the board
[*] Nerfed Beggar Queen, buffed Penny Puncher
[*] Decreased the global app spawn chance very slightly.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allied monsters will no longer spawn directly on top of you when entering a new room, fixing several issues such as being immediately ignited by friendly Devil Slimes
[*] Dodging damage by rolling or via certain Skills will no longer decrease your rating in Winkydink dates.
[*] Fixed a few issues where NPCs would say their lines in a weird order
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck outside the playable area in the final dungeon
[*] Fixed one of Hover Hands’s hands being immune to projectiles
[*] Fixed an issue where you could die after killing certain bosses
[*] Fixed an issue where certain bosses could be killed during their intro cutscenes
[*] Fixed an issue where Exit Strategist could destroy the exit slide, soft locking the run
[*] Fixed an issue where the Elite Winkubus wouldn't do her melee attack
[*] Fixed countless minor edge case issues and we don't remember them all lol
[/list]

notes.title: 1.0.4.5: The Bug Slaying Patch
notes.content:
ːJackie7ː [b]The Bug Slaying Patch (v.1.0.4.5)[/b] is now live on Steam, and it’s only like, 3 weeks later than we told Discord it would be! The main point of this patch is, obviously, to fix the most critical bugs in the game, but we’ve also done quite a bit of balancing work, removed exploits, and even added a sneaky lil feature here and there. Turns out the QA team isn’t happy when you do that, though. Shout out to those folks for putting up with us.

All this stuff is coming to consoles in the upcoming weeks! Stay tuned.

[h2]ːGoOverː Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added an option to turn off the jitter effect in the menus (This was meant to be in to begin with whoops)
[*]You can now control the menus with your controller’s D-pad
[*]There is now a menu option to change between holding the trigger & pressing it to toggle Focus
[*]Attempting to swap inventory slots while attacking or dodge rolling will now buffer the input and swap the weapon once the action ends
[*]“Attack Speed Up” buff now improves the reload time of projectile-type weapons
[*]Added an option to view the credits from the title menu
[*]The dialogue before founder boss fights will now be skipped if you already have their share.
[*]Added the option to invert the camera’s X-Axis control.
[*]Enemies should no longer spawn so close to the player when they first enter a new combat room.
[*]Screenshake algorithm has changed to have a smoother falloff and less intensity when smacking a bunch of environment objects. Try it out!
[*] Confidence Juice and Tappi’s max-level mentor bonus now play music to let you know how long they last.
[*]You can now date the Slime Hand in Winkydink. “Just like real life. -Nick”
[/list]

[h2]ːGoUnderː Balance Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Made earning 5 stars in the Styxcoin Event slightly more lenient
[*]Nerfed the Rifle from 100 shots to 80
[*]You can now use SelfCare+ at max HP and it will grant 2 armor instead of 1
[*]Beggar Queen’s damage bonus has been reduced slightly, and no longer applies to unarmed attacks.
[*] Purchase Protection now only triggers on cash purchases of $10 or more.
[*] Fern’s vending machine will stop working after buying 3-6 cans.
[*] Removed Upcycle+’s old “replacement” functionality and instead made it increase the size of the held item (to potentially hilarious effect)
[*] Slime Hand’s scissor attack has been made a bit easier to avoid.
[*]Extended the length of Retaliatory’s damage buff from 2 seconds to 3.
[*] Fire Grates in Winkydink now turn off when the combat concludes.
[/list]


[h2]ːJoblinː Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where extra connected controllers would fail to function (and even some keyboards & mice from the future would cause this)
[*]Fixed an issue where force closing the game during Ray’s “app announcement scene” could prevent apps from unlocking for the rest of the game
[*]Prevented Eclaire from glitching into walls & floors
[*]Fixed issue where walking Eclaire or possessing a debt ball would cause you to teleport around when riding a vehicle.
[*]Fixed an issue where dollars wouldnt succ to Jackie if she was Downsized
[*]Fixed an issue with a rare Winkydink room containing a weird hat with no weapon icon
[*]Fixed an issue with the Resolution setting in the options where it would only say "1920x1080"
[*]Fixed an issue where enemies wouldnt spawn in a certain room in Styxcoin
[*]Fixed an issue where the options menu showed that the scroll wheel is how to Switch Focus Target on mouse/keyboard. The actual way is with the 1 and 2 keys.
[*]Fixed an issue where the calculator would display as a 2 damage item but hit for 4.
[*]Over-protective now works properly when used as a Pinned Skill
[*]NPC’s names now appear properly in dialogue scenes
[*]Steam achievements relating to completing mentorships now work properly. If you’ve already reached level 4 with a mentor and failed to get their achievement, completing a dungeon run (or just entering a dungeon and abandoning) should grant you the achievement.
[*]Fixed an issue where using Ray’s max-level mentor bonus once would break it (and some other things) until the game was restarted
[*]The Hauntrepreneur’s “shop” will now correctly sometimes spawn a briefcase full of cash instead of an empty slot
[*]You can no longer chill on Swomp’s couch multiple times in the same run
[*]The Styxcoin boss's death explosion will no longer hurt the player
[*]You can no longer exit Avie’s room once entering it
[*]Added a failsafe that should prevent soft locks caused by frozen enemies never unfreezing
[*] The briefcase in the Haunt’s garage will prompt the player to “Acquire” instead of “Buy” it
[*] Prevented Kara’s max-level mentor app spawning while using a different mentor
[*] Fixed a rare soft lock related to the Caffiend’s launch animation
[*]Changed the way Canbassadors spawn in the Caffiend fight, and eliminated the issue where they occasionally fail to activate
[*] Fixed an issue where Emotive would trigger from dodged/blocked damage, occasionally resulting in 1000 slimes spawning and crashing the game
[*] Team Player now reacts properly to the player taking fire damage.
[*] Prevented the player from defeating a boss and triggering the victory cutscene in the same frame as being defeated
[*] Companions now set themselves to either side of Jackie instead of right on top of her when entering new rooms, preventing an issue where you could be shoved into the void by your companions in certain dungeons
[*] Fixed an issue where only Forbidden Flavors would spawn once unlocked
[*] Fixed an issue where using Swomp's chill zone too much would break it permanently
[*] Fixed an issue where the hurtboxes of Hover Hands’ hands were inaccurate.
[*]Prevented an issue where completing a mentor level at the same time as getting the 3rd Share could soft lock game progress until restarted.
[*] Fixed cubes turning bright white when opened.
[*] Fixed an issue where picking up an app in a room that offered a choice between skills would despawn all the skills
[*] Removed a brief moment where the game could be paused during the final cutscene
[*] Removed a brief moment where the background would be visible after the credits ended
[*]Fixed various dialogue typos
[/list]

[i][b][h2]Various spoilers below. Read at your own risk![/h2][/b][/i]
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[h3](Midgame spoilers)[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where Ferryman Hustlebones could fail to find his way to the topdeck, leading to easy damage against him.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where the 10x Caffiend’s big leap animation could get him stuck outside the playable area.[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Fixed an issue where upon beating the 10x Caffiend, the drone would drop the box outside the playable area.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3](Endgame spoilers)[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where traveling from Floor 999 to Floor 1000 of Cubicle Tower could sometimes grant you a Union Buster when you already had one.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Avie can no longer be damaged during cutscenes with specific skills[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Prevented certain skills from dealing bonus damage during the Avie fight[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Fixed Eclaire not being cursed in the end cutscene.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes:[/h2]
[h3](Midgame Spoilers) Various Balance changes to [spoiler]Mask off Hover Hands[/spoiler]:[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]increased health of first and second phases[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]hands are invincible while clapping[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]less downtime between attacks[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]ice shuriken now targets you more accurately[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]some of the ice and fire grates in the room have been removed[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]graphical improvements such as new strobe lights, shiny nail polish, and a better cutscene animation[/spoiler]
[/list]

[h3](Endgame Spoilers) Various Balance changes to the final fight:[/h3]
[list]
[*][spoiler]Slowed down lasers in the fight slightly, decreased their hitbox size, and increased the damage they do to enemies.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Increased Core’s cooldown slightly after using its explosion or punch attack[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Normal enemies during the first & second phase of the fight will take damage normally rather than dying after a certain number of hits. They will also spawn constantly, urging the player to kill them or get overwhelmed.[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Fixed an issue where the boss could knock Jackie down unfairly without playing the shockwave animation[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]After viewing Kara’s cutscene in the final fight, the associated cutscenes will no longer trigger during the same play session[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]Increased the durability of the Union Buster[/spoiler]
[/list]


Header art by [url=https://twitter.com/100DARKSTAR]100DARKSTAR[/url]. We've been seeing some AMAZING FANART so if you've made any, send it our way via:

[url=discord.gg/aggrocrab]Aggro Crab Discord[/url]
[url=twitter.com/aggrocrabgames]Aggro Crab Twitter[/url]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.3.1 Live!
notes.content:
Hey Interns!

Launch has been incredible and we've been overwhelmed by the positivity but we wanted to get this update for the two biggest issues out as quickly as possible! Hotfix 1.0.3.1 is now live.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Capped FPS at 60 by default, and set the maximum cap at 120. This should resolve the persistent crashes for the majority of users experiencing them, and will serve as a temporary fix until we can address the underlying issue and hopefully allow uncapped FPS again.
[*]Buying an object with Blood Money will not restock it when using Tappi's mentor bonus, preventing an infinite health & skill exploit.
[*]Fixed an issue where going down a slide while holding Debt could duplicate the Debt.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Debt now drops when you dodge roll & encumbers your movement (although can still be swung fast) when using Upper Body Strength.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35928655/e8d35a534c416276edfa66f9108a0be182fab5bd.jpg[/img]
[i]This bug hit a little too close to home[/i]

We're also still working on a bunch of other reports all you lovely people have submitted since launch! These updates are getting pushed much more rapidly to our [b]Public Beta Branch.[/b] If you wanna help us test our bugfixes and new features before they go out for everyone, the steps for downloading the beta branch are:

[olist]
[*]right click the game on your Steam library and select "properties"
[*]in the menu that opens, select the "betas" tab
[*]pick "public_beta" from the dropdown and let the games begin
[/olist]

Thanks to everyone that's taken the time to leave us a review, give us feedback and report issues. Have fun smashing monsters with junk and stuff!

[b]For all the latest updates follow or join the pages below:[/b]
[url= https://twitter.com/AggroCrabGames]Aggro Crab Twitter[/url]
[url= https://discord.gg/Aggrocrab]Aggro Crab Discord[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd]Team17 Twitter[/url]
[url= https://www.facebook.com/Team17/]Team17 Facebook[/url]
[url= https://www.facebook.com/GoingUnderGame]Going Under Facebook[/url]
